data.name: AppTitle
data.comment: Window title and application name.

data.name: MainWindowAutomationName
data.comment: Name announced by screen readers for the main window.

data.name: JobListAutomationName
data.comment: Name announced by screen readers for the list of downloads.

data.name: JobColumnName
data.comment: Column header: file name of a download.

data.name: JobColumnState
data.comment: Column header: state of a download.

data.name: JobColumnProgress
data.comment: Column header: percent done.

data.name: JobColumnSize
data.comment: Column header: total size of a download.

data.name: SettingsTitle
data.comment: Title of the Settings window.

data.name: SettingsAutomationName
data.comment: Name announced by screen readers for the Settings window.

data.name: SettingsGeneralTab
data.comment: Settings tab: general options.

data.name: SettingsBrowserTab
data.comment: Settings tab: browser integration.

data.name: SettingsGeneralPlaceholder
data.value: General options arrive with the main window.
data.comment: Shown on the General tab until it has content.

data.name: BrowserInterceptionEnabled
data.comment: Check box: switch interception of browser downloads on or off.

data.name: BrowserExtensionsLabel
data.value: File extensions (one per line, no dot)
data.comment: Label of the list of file extensions Kasi takes from the browser.

data.name: BrowserMimeTypesLabel
data.value: MIME types (one per line, for example video/*)
data.comment: Label of the list of MIME types Kasi takes from the browser.

data.name: BrowserExcludedSitesLabel
data.value: Sites the browser keeps (one per line; subdomains included)
data.comment: Label of the list of sites whose downloads are never taken.

data.name: BrowserBypassKeyLabel
data.value: Hold this key while clicking to let the browser download
data.comment: Label of the bypass key choice.

data.name: BrowserMinSizeLabel
data.value: Smallest file to take, in megabytes (0 takes any size)
data.comment: Label of the minimum size.

data.name: BypassKeyAlt
data.comment: Bypass key name.

data.name: BypassKeyCtrl
data.comment: Bypass key name.

data.name: BypassKeyShift
data.comment: Bypass key name.

data.name: BypassKeyNone
data.comment: Bypass key choice that turns the bypass off.

data.name: SettingsSaveButton
data.comment: Button that saves the settings.

data.name: SettingsCancelButton
data.comment: Button that closes the Settings window without saving.

data.name: SettingsSaveFailed
data.value: The settings could not be saved.
data.comment: Shown when saving the settings file failed.
